title: 时装板式轮播｜同一成年模特、服装章节与主标回归
source_title: 红黑白时装索引｜同一成年模特跨造型海报章节
summary: 先锁定同一成年模特，再让不同造型在统一红黑白网格、编号和字块中逐章轮转；版式节拍替代随机换景，终局以同一人物和总标题完成身份回扣。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original fashion subject with at least three stable identity anchors. + Rotate distinct style modules while changing only declared wardrobe, accessory, palette and typography variables. + Bind every module to subject action, camera movement and foreground motion while preserving identity. + Insert one authored low-density pause after the maximum-intensity phase. + Return prior modules as a compressed recall and finish on the same adult in one stable hero frame.
recommended_input: 建立原创成年模特：银色短发，置于海军蓝、米白与珊瑚红编辑网格中，主标题为【FORM INDEX】。；用一张近景肖像与一张全身姿态交替，始终保留同一网格坐标和章节编号。；回到银发模特的稳定英雄姿态，并在准确标题【FORM INDEX / 05】下定格。
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity persists across every outfit and crop.
Each outfit occupies a discrete graphic chapter with no mid-body morphing.
Close and full views alternate without changing the subject's anatomy.
The master title and identity return together in the terminal lockup.
